storyCards.headline: Slow An' Easy: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Whitesnake's "Slow An' Easy" — original release 1984. "Slow an' Easy" is a song by the British rock band Whitesnake from their 1984 album Slide It In, released at the end of May 1984 in the US.

Artist: Whitesnake · Title: Slow An' Easy · Album: Super Rock '84 In Japan · Year: 1984 · Genre: Rock · Path: /Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/1980's/Whitesnake - Slow An' Easy.mp4.

The album provided the group with a commercial breakthrough in the United States, and this specific song, which was released as a promo single, became a hit on rock radio.

"Slow an' Easy" and "Love Ain't No Stranger" reached #17 and #34 on Billboard's Mainstream Rock Tracks chart, respectively.
